tags.chapter_name: Center of Mass Momentum and Collision

question.text: Two particles $A$ and $B$ (both initially at rest) start moving towards each other under a mutual force of attraction. At the instant, when the speed of $A$ is $v$ and the speed of $B$ is $2 v$, the speed of the centre of mass is

solution.text:
In the absence of external force the speed
$$
u_{\mathrm{co}}=0
$$
$F_{ext}=0$ then
$$
v_{\mathrm{cm} .}=0 \text { always }
$$
